parameters.content: LAIW — Branded Explainer Factory — inactive staging. Up to two new article-based 1080×1350 diagrams for next-day 10:00/15:00 Mountain. The exact visual layout is generated with deterministic HTML and icons + existing Gotenberg renderer (no public graphic generator webhook or paid creative-model call), and page/diagram text comes from a published WordPress article. PNG binary signature and dimensions must pass; preview mode does not upload or write to Queue. To enable owner-approved Draft creation, set Configuration and Safety Mode to draft_write_enabled and activate, only after real image review and downstream integration tests. Keep every new post Status Draft; current human Queue Approved gate + article-first social distributor remain unchanged.
